description: This file defines the LoanRepayment class and related functions for managing loan repayment processes, including validation, accounting entries, interest accrual, penalties, and interactions with other loan management components.

classes.name: LoanRepayment
classes.description: A class managing the lifecycle and accounting of loan repayment transactions, including validation, interest booking, and accounting entries.

methods.name: create_repayment_entry
methods.description: Creates a new loan repayment record with specified details.

methods.name: get_accrued_interest_entries
methods.description: Retrieves unpaid interest accrual entries for a given loan up to a specified posting date.

methods.name: get_penalty_details
methods.description: Fetches the pending penalty amount and date for a given loan.

methods.name: get_amounts
methods.description: Calculates various amounts related to loan repayment, including interest, penalties, and due dates.

methods.name: calculate_amounts
methods.description: Public function that wraps get_amounts to compute repayment amounts based on loan and posting date, with optional closure adjustments.
